name: lag_24
availability: sessions at the same hour of the previous day
reason: Strongest single lag (Section 5.3) and known for every horizon.

name: lag_48
availability: sessions at the same hour two days before
reason: A second daily value smooths one unusual day.

name: lag_168
availability: sessions at the same hour one week before
reason: Carries the weekday pattern of the target day.

name: same_hour_mean_7d
availability: mean of the same hour over the 7 previous days
reason: Averaging removes part of the hour-to-hour noise.

name: same_hour_mean_4w
availability: mean of the same hour and weekday over the 4 previous weeks
reason: Weekday-matched level; also the mean_4w baseline.

name: prev_day_total
availability: sessions on day D-1 (window ends with the hour starting at D-1 23:00)
reason: Most recent daily level, complete at 00:00.

name: prev_7day_total
availability: sessions on days D-7 to D-1
reason: Weekly level, less affected by one unusual day.

name: hour_of_day
availability: clock hour of the target, equal to the horizon minus 1
reason: Main daily pattern (Section 5.2).

name: day_of_week
availability: weekday of the target day
reason: Weekly pattern (Section 5.2).

name: is_holiday
availability: public holiday from the State Council calendar
reason: Holiday effect (Section 5.4).

name: is_adjusted_workday
availability: weekend day worked in exchange for a holiday
reason: They differ from both weekdays and weekends (Section 5.4).

name: month
availability: calendar month of the target day
reason: Slow seasonal change.

name: level
availability: network or district of the row, fixed before any forecast
reason: Lets one shared model serve the four levels.

name: daily temperature, humidity, precipitation
availability: known at 00:00 only as a weather forecast for day D
reason: Usable only if a daily weather forecast is assumed known at 00:00; Task 2 tests it (Section 5.7).

name: observed weather of day D
availability: recorded during the target day, after the issuance
reason: Observed future weather is not available at issuance.

name: lags 1 to 23 hours
availability: known only for the horizons shorter than the lag
reason: Not available for every horizon under midnight issuance.

name: any session starting after D 00:00
availability: after the issuance
reason: Leakage.

name: energy, costs, payment amounts
availability: recorded when a session ends
reason: Describe sessions, not how many start; not needed for the counts.

name: end cause and fault flags
availability: recorded when a session ends
reason: Outcomes of single sessions, known only after they end.

name: user and post identifiers, location type
availability: attributes of single sessions
reason: The series aggregate over users and posts.
